source_title: Meet Odungakudiyar, the sacred bull that unites two faiths
source_excerpt: aHtuRy4c ThE BULL AT THE HEART OF 300 YEARS OF HARMONY In Sekkipatti, Tamil Nadu, a sacred bull named Odungakudiyar embodies a centuries-old tradition of Hindu-Muslim harmony. Rooted in local belief and shared customs, the bull represents a unique bond between two faiths, preserved across generations. From temple rituals to prayers at the Odungakudiyar Dargah, this is a story of faith, coexistence and a village united by tradition.
